translations.web: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.
translations.bsb: Nations rage, kingdoms crumble; the earth melts when He lifts His voice.
translations.kjv: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
translations.asv: The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved: He uttered his voice, the earth melted.
